narrative: Study size: 20 event charts read from Jagannatha Hora 7.66, whole-sign houses from the Lagna it calculated.
Sign occupancy is most uneven for Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu (higher chi-square vs a uniform 12-sign baseline).

Highest-frequency repeats: Ketu in Magha (100.0%); Jupiter in Cancer (100.0%); Saturn in Pisces (100.0%); Ketu in Leo (100.0%); Mars in Gemini (80.0%); Jupiter in Ashlesha (70.0%); Saturn in Revati (70.0%); Venus in Virgo (70.0%).
Most repeated yoga-like flag: Kemadruma-like (empty 2nd/12th from Moon) in 5 of 20 charts (25.0%).
Most common Rahu–Ketu axis: Libra — Leo (65.0%).
Lift is relative to a naive uniform baseline (12 signs / 12 houses / 27 nakshatras). It is a ranking aid, not a proof of causation. Earthquake geology is not claimed to be caused by planets.
